title: Derive and dispatch one complete Project setup

requirements.invariant: One Project setup binds stable Account, Project and authoritative account-scoped Client identity plus the complete selected-category set and exact nullable allocations as one observable operation. Project name is required, description is already canonicalized by the verified selection, and attachment upload remains a separate durable-media lifecycle.

Existing or new Client selection uses stable same-Account Client identity. Client display text, route, source free text and provider path cannot own or authorize the Project relationship; setup cannot rename, archive, merge, reassign or correct Client or Project identity.

Zero enabled categories is valid. Selected categories preserve exact absent versus selected-null, selected-zero and selected-positive allocation intent; allocation is nonnegative integer-currency Money with no inherited 32-bit cap or invented Project-wide currency rule.

The application boundary consumes the existing ProjectSetupFormSelection and current ProjectSetupFormPreparation. It adds no alternate raw form/draft/failure/readiness type, no default selection or ready-only gate, and no UI state, route, provider identity or authorization claim. Matching represented ready, partial or stale evidence remains admissible exactly as the verified selection contract defines; any changed preparation fingerprint is refused before dispatch.

ProjectSetupUseCase receives existing typed selection/current preparation plus caller ProjectID, OperationID, PrincipalID, contract version and finite capture time; derives the verified CreateProjectCommand before invoking ProjectSetupOperating.create exactly once; validates the receipt; returns the exact receipt and LocalOperationState; preserves CancellationError, ProjectSetupFormFailure and ProjectSetupFailure; and maps every other port error to ProjectSetupFailure.localAcceptanceFailed.

This target-only slice advances only its two claimed leaves. NewProjectView, ProjectFormValidation and its current tests remain target_mapped, while ProjectService remains characterized; source UI validation, Firebase writes and related surfaces do not advance.

Exactly two target-only leaves may change. Physical local persistence, optimistic Project projection, authoritative authorization/audit/apply, Postgres/Data API/RLS/PowerSync/provider behavior, app/MCP wiring, Firebase migration, hosted resources, production, release and cutover do not advance.

items: ProjectSetupUseCase reuses ProjectSetupFormSelection, ProjectSetupFormPreparation and CreateProjectCommand rather than inventing a second form or operation model.
Selection command derivation revalidates exact current represented evidence and finishes before any ProjectSetupOperating call.
The use case invokes ProjectSetupOperating.create once, validates and returns the exact receipt, preserves both typed failure families and Swift cancellation, and bounds unknown port failures.
No readiness, default-selection, category-definition, Client/Project lifecycle/correction, media, UI, persistence, authorization or provider policy is added.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: No Client, Project, category, allocation, operation, attachment, table, view, function, constraint, index or migration change.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No trusted Project setup handler, membership/reference lookup, collision check, idempotency store, audit assignment or server transaction is implemented; the injected port remains an application boundary.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No Data API relation/function or grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed local preparation/selection is not authorization; no Account, Client, Project, category or operation policy/test is added.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Project/Client/category/operation row, upload connector or synchronized visibility exists.

localOffline.notApplicable: The use case is network-independent behind a port and preserves the existing offline-capable represented-evidence semantics, but adds no physical persistence, restart write, optimistic Project row or rejection recovery.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Project setup dispatch owns no hero attachment identity, bytes, reference, upload, retention or deletion behavior; O-023 remains outside.

appMcp.notApplicable: No SwiftUI steps/loading/defaults/errors/dismissal/navigation, app composition, MCP schema/tool/resource/catalog or transport is added.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Project/clientName/category/media callback, source export row or migration mapping is decoded or transformed.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Only existing bounded failures are values; no telemetry, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook is added.

items: Implementation may change only the two provider-free target leaves; NewProjectView, ProjectFormValidation/tests, ProjectService, current Firebase app, MCP and app projects remain unchanged.
The deterministic in-memory port cannot physically or authoritatively create a Client/Project/category allocation, upload media, authorize, synchronize, deploy, migrate, release or cut over.

O-023/O-024/O-025/O-026 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain open or outside because media retention, lifecycle/correction, reference authorization, providers and production behavior are excluded.

verification.expected: Existing- and new-Client selections dispatch once from exact matching ready, partial and stale represented evidence. Zero categories and absent/null/zero/large-positive mixed-currency allocations remain exact; selection-owned name/description normalization passes through without defaults, a 32-bit cap or an invented currency rule.

Account mismatch, every Client/category evidence mutation including quality/completeness/version/as-of/query/count/order/row/eligibility changes, and nonfinite capture time fail during existing typed derivation with zero port calls. No raw malformed-input surface or alternate readiness policy is invented.

Every matching LocalOperationState returns in the exact validated receipt after exactly one create call carrying the verified Project subject, zero preconditions and complete setup payload; receipt mismatch fails after one call.

A reciprocal flattened encoded-leaf matrix independently varies Account, Project, existing/new Client identity and name, Project name/description, every category/allocation component, Operation, actor, contract and time; each value reaches only its existing owning command fields. Rebuilt selections over valid preparation-only evidence changes produce no command-leaf change.

Each ProjectSetupFormFailure, each ProjectSetupFailure, arbitrary raw port failure and CancellationError remain distinct after the correct zero/one-call boundary; derivation stays outside the port catch and raw provider detail never crosses the application boundary.

All 12 form and 16 operation diagnostics plus exact encoded command topology expose only the authorized draft/envelope/subject/fingerprint setup fields, empty preconditions and exact Client/allocation/Money shapes—never preparation/readiness evidence, raw errors, UI/default/category-definition/media/lifecycle/correction/history/accounting/provider/credential/production fields.

verification.owner: conversion control and independent actual-diff review
verification.expected: The READY commit changes only two comment scaffolds and control/evidence files, passes all controls/tests/builds, and leaves NewProjectView, ProjectFormValidation/tests, ProjectService and every Firebase/app/MCP/provider surface at prior status and content.

Separate exact READY and implementation commits pass immutable traceability, source/provider isolation, generated contracts, complete tests, repeatable project generation, both staging builds and clean artifacts; only implementation CI can promote the two target leaves to verified.

notes: Implemented locally after exact READY commit 863f6fce14332af0f43aa1a82480e44bc790ca56 passed immutable Actions run 33791245215. Exactly two target leaves now derive the existing verified CreateProjectCommand before one ProjectSetupOperating.create call, validate and return its receipt, preserve both typed failure families and cancellation, and bound raw port failures. Independent implementation review found three P2 proof gaps: nil-description omission, same-identity existing-to-new Client discrimination, and allocation-order equivalence. Corrected tests close each gap; both final reviewers return GO. Conversion/target controls, repeatable project hashes 0657194a / 388303af and both staging builds pass locally. NewProjectView, ProjectFormValidation/tests and ProjectService remain unadvanced; all UI/default/category mutation/media, persistence, authorization, provider/schema/RLS/Sync, app/MCP, migration, hosted and production exclusions remain binding. Exact implementation-commit CI remains required before verification.
